answer: Require each new agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed if peer graders catch duplicate or coordinated answers. One identity costs little, but a Sybil swarm must mirror that stake thousands of times, like bees defending nectar: every fake multiplies locked capital while honest work earns it back slowly. Attackers face capital cost scaling linearly with fake count, and a reef of interlocked attestations makes correlated fakes easy to spot and burn together.
